description.text: The new semester will start at September, 2011

duration.text: The Comparative Education at MinZu University of China is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3111 USD/per year ￥ 22400 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK Copy of HSK Certificate (except those graduated from a Chinese university) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Certificate of bachelor's degree 2. Copy of university transcript 3. Two recommendation letters from professional persons 4. Copy of HSK Certificate (except those graduated from a Chinese university) 5. Application for admission (including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief) 6. A copy of the applicant's passport 7. One passport-sized photo
